whatItDoes.body: Fund the card however you already move money: bank transfer, exchange withdrawal, or stablecoins (USDC, USDT). Your balance is yours. Non-custodial. No monthly fees. No annual fees.

whoItsFor.title: If you live in more than one country, this is for you.
whoItsFor.body: We built peanut for people who don't fit. Digital nomads who get bounced by every neobank's verification the moment they cross a border. Expats who pay 4% on every transaction home. Cross-border users who earn in one currency and spend in another.

notForYou.title: Probably not for you.
notForYou.body1: If your money lives in one country and one currency, your bank card already works. Keep it.
notForYou.body2: If your money lives elsewhere — across borders, in dollars, in self-custody — the peanut card was built for you.

q1.question: WHAT'S THE PEANUT CARD?
q1.answer: A non-custodial card. Top up with stablecoins, then use the card for everyday spending wherever Visa is accepted.

q2.question: WHERE DOES IT WORK?
q2.answer: Accepted wherever Visa is accepted — about 150 million merchants. Online, in-store, ATMs.

q3.question: IS MY MONEY SAFE?
q3.answer: It's yours. Non-custodial — your stablecoins stay in your wallet until the moment you use the card. We don't hold custody. We don't lend it out.

q5.question: HOW LONG IS THE WAITLIST?
q5.answer: We're letting in about 50 people a week during closed beta. Order matters. Badges skip the line entirely.

q6.question: CAN I USE IT WHERE I LIVE?
q6.answer: It's a Visa card — accepted wherever Visa is accepted, in shops, online and at ATMs. Sign in and try the door to see what's next for your account.

q7.question: ANY FEES?
q7.answer: No monthly fees. No annual fees. Standard fees and limits apply per the cardholder terms.

q8.question: WHY "SHHHHH"?
q8.answer: We'd rather under-promise and over-deliver to a small group than blast the whole internet on day one. Word travels.
